definition: The student completed multiple tasks to a roughly similar standard of quality and completeness. Compare standards rather than task size, complexity, or time spent. One task alone does not establish consistency.
positive_criteria: Multiple completed tasks show comparable care, validation, and completeness
Describes consistently meeting the same acceptance or quality standard across tasks
negative_criteria: Reports uneven quality or completeness across comparable tasks
Some tasks meet the expected standard while others have acknowledged omissions or avoidable defects
